title: Sofronio Vasquez lends voice to Asean song ‘Seas Unbroken’
summary: After making history as the first Filipino and first male Asian winner of “The Voice” Season 26, Sofronio Vasquez is lending his voice to a song celebrating unity among Southeast Asian nations.…

blocks.text: After making history as the first Filipino and first male Asian winner of “The Voice” Season 26, Sofronio Vasquez is lending his voice to a song celebrating unity among Southeast Asian nations. Vasquez recently performed “Seas Unbroken” for the first time alongside the Young Voices of the Philippines (YVP) aboard the Wish 107.5 Bus. The collaboration brings together Vasquez, whose victory on the US singing competition catapulted him to the international spotlight, and the young choral artists of YVP, one of the scholar choirs of the Treble Choir Association of the Philippines.
